On an ambient loop, dispose clears uid at the call site but even synchronous unload callbacks run after a checkpoint.
LOADING inertia exists before internal/status observers run; reentrant disposal invalidates the epoch and joins the load.
Publication rollback settlement remains owned and awaitable; a single asyncio.sleep(0) is not a completion contract.
Ambient-loop emit enters each async listener before invoking the next listener; asynchronous failure is reported without stopping peer dispatch.
An async iterator next already in flight transfers its yielded disposer even after epoch invalidation; do not request another next.
Cancelling a Python dispose observer does not cancel owned cleanup or retire the parent effect before settlement.
Loader update retains entry/options identity; remove detaches the fiber but retains the store row until cleanup settles.
HMR refresh serialization is keyed by registration identity; pending events coalesce, different identities may run independently.
An old config registration disposal joins its own refresh and must not remove the replacement registration at the same path.
Include initial apply and subsequent refreshes share serialization; publish content/data only after the child-tree transaction commits. A failed predecessor does not block the next refresh.
Repeated public plugin-fiber dispose is a no-op; the structural parent still joins shared cleanup through its owned effect. Root disposal remains restartable.
Registry handle identity differs from Context.fiber and runtime.fibers. Method await first settles the handle, then assimilates its then closure to the original, including original startup errors.
Module import failure retains old runtime and restores dependency caches; apply failure remains on the new FAILED fiber and does not imply import rollback.
Subsequent module changes resolve the current replacement runtime; raw old fibers are never mutated into replacements.
A multi-module reload imports every changed module before disposing old runtimes; dependency cache restoration includes package attributes and cyclic relative imports.
Preset composition binds an agent scope key to a standing scope key; it must not change Context or fiber ancestry.
Agent factory awaits setup before publication; prompt sections and model tool schemas resolve the same agent scope.
A resolved standing Future must yield before guarded generation-pointer replacement, matching the upstream Promise checkpoint.
